def bias_vec(A, z, u, cap, W, w):
    out = []
    for e in range(len(cap)):
        X = sum(A[ww][e] / cap[e] for ww in range(W))
        out.append(A[w][e] / cap[e] + (z[e] - X - u[e]) / W)
    return out
